jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
Leads the end-to-end budgeting, forecasting, and performance reporting cycle across the Group's business lines (brands,

after-sales, and mobility), translating automotive market dynamics, FX movements, and unit economics into financial insight.

Acts as a business partner to business-line heads and senior management, owning key financial models and guiding junior

analysts to drive profitability and informed decision-making.

**Budgeting, Forecasting & Planning**

1.Lead the annual budget and rolling forecast cycle across business lines, coordinating with brand, sales, and after-

sales heads and consolidating at Group level.

2.Build and own driver-based models covering vehicle volumes, model mix, pricing, dealer/fleet margins, after-sales

and parts revenue, and operating costs.

3.Prepare the 3–5 year strategic plan and scenario/sensitivity analysis for key drivers such as EGP exchange rate,

import duties, interest rates, and market demand.

**Performance Analysis & Reporting**

4.Own the monthly close reporting pack: actual vs. budget/forecast/prior year variance analysis with clear root-cause

commentary for senior management.

5.Prepare and review monthly management reports, financial analysis, and performance dashboards

6.Analyze profitability by brand, model, branch, channel (retail, fleet/B2B, rental), and activity (sales and aftersales),

including gross margin per unit, inventory ageing, and working capital.

7.Design and maintain KPI dashboards (Power BI / SAP) tracking sales volume, market share, revenue per unit,

service absorption, OPEX ratios, and cash conversion.

8.Present insights and recommendations to the FP&A Manager, Finance Director, and business-line management.

**Business Partnering & Decision Support**

9.Act as finance business partner for assigned business lines, challenging assumptions and supporting pricing,

incentive, and commercial decisions.

10.Evaluate business cases and investments (new brands, showrooms, fleet purchases, localization projects) using

NPV, IRR, payback, and break-even analysis.

11.Monitor cost structures and lead cost optimization initiatives to protect margins in a volatile, FX-driven market.

12.Analyze inventory and stock-financing costs, receivables exposure, and credit risk with Treasury and Credit Control.

13.Prepare, validate, and review monthly sales commissions in line with approved policies

14.Review and validate PRs and POs from a budgetary and financial control perspective within delegated authority

15.Support the FP&A Manager in providing financial insights and recommendations to brand management

Process, Systems & People

16.Improve FP&A processes, templates, and reporting automation within SAP S/4HANA and BI tools to shorten cycle

times and improve data accuracy.

17.Ensure compliance with financial policies, internal controls, Egyptian Accounting Standards, and IFRS in all planning

and reporting outputs.

18.Review the work of and coach junior FP&A analysts/specialists, ensuring quality and timeliness of deliverables.

 **Requirements**  

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
* CMA, CFA (Level II+), ACCA, or FMVA certification is a strong plus; MBA is an advantage.
* 4–6 years of experience in FP&A, financial analysis, or corporate finance, with at least 2 years at senior
* level; automotive, distribution, or multi-business-line group experience strongly preferred.
* Advanced Excel (financial modeling, scenario analysis) and Power BI,hands-on SAP S/4HANA (FI/CO) experience.
* Strong knowledge of IFRS and Egyptian Accounting Standards.
* Proven track record leading budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis cycles.
* Understanding of automotive business drivers: unit economics, model mix, after-sales, inventory, and FX/import cost impact.
* Investment appraisal and business case evaluation (NPV, IRR, payback).
* Strong business partnering, stakeholder management, and ability to challenge constructively.
* Excellent presentation skills for reporting to C-level executives.
* Ability to coach junior team members and manage multiple deadlines.

jobs.title: Private Banking Key Clients Portfolio Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Accountabilities**

* Develop and leverage an in depth understanding of Key clients’ needs within the private banking by assessing customer needs and conducting customer surveys to be able to provide high competitive range of product and service

* Build and lead a best in class customer experience, demonstrating the ability to understand the technical, social and emotional values that have critical business significance.

* Market the full range of products & service to Private Banking clients’ segmentation and contribute effectively in achieving the Private Banking budget while identifying and meeting customer needs

* Manage and increase the portfolio by acquiring NTB private banking customers and cross sell EG-Bank services and products to existing and prospective customers

* Handling all Private Banking customers’ inquiries and complaints and ensure resolving them efficiently within the set TAT while delivering a consistent and tailored private management service to Private Banking clients and developing a long term, in depth client relationship.

* Analyze portfolio performance statistics to better understand customer behavior and plan for future activities with a continuous focus towards helping the client to adapt to changes in personal circumstances and financial environment

* Review daily inflows/outflows of the assigned portfolio to retain clients and avoid losing funds

* Respond positively and diligently to colleagues and coordinate and communicate effectively with the Branches and support units to ensure that customers’ requests are processed timely and effectively

**Qualifications and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Accounting or its equivalence.
* 6 to 8 years of experience in any retail field preferred exposure with portfolio management
* Proven record of building relationships and closing business
* Successful track record of sales and aggressive targets achievements
* Experience in Retail & Customer Service areas is a must.

**Skills:**

* Excellent writing, communication and presentation skills
* Strong Analytical and Numerical Skills
* Strong Interpersonal, communication and networking skills
* Self-driven and results oriented with a positive outlook and clear focus on delivering results.
* Good leadership skills.
* Sales & Target Oriented
* Well organized, accurate, self-driven, problem solver and has the ability to work under stress & pressure.

jobs.description:

**Job Description & Summary**

About the role
  
  
As a Senior Associate you should have strong business, technical, analytical and commercial skills and be able to apply your knowledge to provide finance advice to ETIC stakeholders in line with PwC policies and accounting standards.
  
  
You will be working for a new business and therefore have the opportunity to grow with the company, take on more responsibility over time and progress your career.
  
  
You will report to the Finance Manager. You will liaise with and work alongside other finance and operations functions, you will develop a network of key contacts, build strong relationships and develop new skills.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage accounts receivable processes, including accurate and timely billing to territories based on networking days and agreed-upon terms.

* Ensure billing adjustments for resource trades between territories are correctly processed.

* Reconcile inter-territory transactions and resolve discrepancies with stakeholders.

* Perform stakeholder engagement to address inquiries, provide updates, and ensure alignment on billing and payment processes.

* Track and manage monthly networking days and align invoicing schedules accordingly.

* Conduct data analysis to support accurate billing and reporting, including variance analysis and trade impact assessments.

* Maintain comprehensive accounts receivable records and ensure compliance with policies and deadlines.

* Support the month-end and year-end closing processes by reconciling accounts and preparing relevant reports.

* Assist in developing and improving billing workflows and internal controls.

Provide insights and recommendations through analysis of receivable trends to enhance collections and reduce outstanding balances.  



**Role Requirements:**

* Analytical mindset with the ability to handle complex billing structures and trade adjustments between territories.

* Building Dashboards using Power Query , Dax , SQL, Etc…...

* Strong interpersonal skills for stakeholder management and issue resolution.

* Intermediate to advanced skills in Excel or Google Sheets (e.g., pivot tables, lookups, formulas).

* Experience with accounting software (e.g., Sun, Sage) and reporting tools.

* Ability to interpret financial data and provide actionable recommendations.

* Detail-oriented and highly organised to manage large volumes of billing data.

* Proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills for preparing reports and presentations.

* Agile and adaptable, embracing innovation and change.

Ability to prioritize tasks effectively and work collaboratively with other departments.  



**The skills we look for in future employees**

**All our people need to demonstrate the skills and behaviours that support us in delivering our business strategy. This is important to the work we do for our business, and our clients. These skills and behaviours make up our global leadership framework, ‘The PwC Professional’.**

**The PwC Professional focuses on five core attributes; whole leadership, business acumen, technical and digital, global and inclusive, and relationships. We use this framework to recruit, develop and assess our people, at all grades and all areas of our business, because we expect all of our people to be leaders.**
